healthCheck.alreadyResponded: You have already responded to this health check

incrementIntegration.differentTeam: Prior increment must belong to the same team
incrementIntegration.sameIncrement: Current and prior increment must be different
incrementIntegration.verificationRequired: Increment cannot be verified: integration verification is required. All prior Increments must have PASSED integration tests.

productGoal.noProductGoal: This Sprint is not linked to a Product Goal

COMMITMENT.definition: Personally committing to the objectives of the Scrum Team.
COMMITMENT.question: Do you feel the team is personally committed to achieving the Sprint Goal?

COURAGE.definition: Having the courage to commit, do the right thing, and work on tough problems.
COURAGE.question: Do you feel the team has the courage to raise issues and tackle tough problems?

FOCUS.definition: Focusing on the work of the Sprint and the goals of the Scrum Team.
FOCUS.question: Do you feel the team focuses on the Sprint work without distraction?

OPENNESS.definition: Being open about the work and the challenges with performing the work.
OPENNESS.question: Do you feel the team is open about progress and challenges?

RESPECT.definition: Respecting each other to be capable, independent people.
RESPECT.question: Do you feel team members respect one another's skills and independence?
